subject_session: Achilles / Achilles_10252013 (primary); pipeline also started on Cicero_09012014, Cicero_09172014, Gatsby_08022013, Buddy_06272013 but did not finish

headline_stat.name: Fraction of CA1 pyramidal cells classified as place cells (either direction, 85/120)

stated_limitation: Three of the eight sessions used a circular maze. The direction-flip below assumes an open-ended linear track, so the analysis is limited to the five linear-track sessions (Cicero_09172014 used a 2 m track, the rest 1.6 m).

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 (Grosmark & Buzsaki CA1 linear-track silicon probe recordings, subject Achilles) is the canonical choice for hippocampal place fields, with 120 putative pyramidal cells and 83 traversals.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via LINDI with the mislabelled SpatialSeries rate/period corrected, traversals segmented from the NaN structure with dropout bridging and a 60% coverage criterion, speed thresholding, explicit spike-count and peak-rate inclusion criteria, and a committed linearisation-validation panel.
justification.analysis: Skaggs spatial information against a within-running-epoch circular-shift null (with a well-reasoned justification for why a whole-epoch shift would be wrong), odd/even lap stability, direction-separated rate maps, and cross-validated Bayesian decoding with a map-permutation control; only a multiple-comparison correction across the 69 tested units is absent, and it would not change the direction of the result.
justification.correctness: 56%/50% per direction and 71% either-direction place cells, median SI 0.63 bits/spike, 28 cm fields, and 5.5 cm decoding error versus 50.1 cm control are all inside the preregistered ranges and consistent between the logs, the figure titles and the figures themselves.
justification.figures: Figures 1-7 are readable, labelled with units and sample sizes, and the population-map triptych and confusion matrix make the case cleanly, but the Figure 7 posterior panel is obscured by the overplotted true-position trace and a clipped legend, and the referenced Figure 8 does not exist.
justification.honesty: Nothing produced is misrepresented and the run's final report honestly states the multi-session loop reached only session 4 of 5, but the committed Summary and Figure 8 caption assert a five-session result that no output supports, and no limitation of the primary result (single session, near-zero attrition at the significance step) is acknowledged.
justification.verdict: The core single-session analysis is publication-quality and I would believe it, but I would require the multi-session claims to either be backed by a completed run or removed, plus the missing README and the Figure 7 rendering fix.
